message: Tottenham Court Road Station: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available from the Oxford Street entrance due to a faulty lift. For step free access, use the entrance on New Oxford Street or Dean Street. Call 0343 222 1234 if you need further help.

Chadwell Heath Station: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the westbound Elizabeth line platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.
Brockley Station: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the northbound platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Highbury & Islington: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the Mildmay and Windrush lines platforms 2 and 7 (trains via Willesden Junction and via Canada Water). Take a train from platform 8 to Canonbury and change there.

Canada Water : Step free access is not available between the ticket hall and street level due to a faulty lift. Step free access between lines is still available. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need more information.
Step free access is not available between the footbridge and platform 3 (towards Reading) due to a faulty lift. Call 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Victoria: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to/from the Cardinal Place entrance due to a faulty lift. Use the entrance at the National Rail station for step free access. Call 0343 222 1234 if you need further help

ELEPHANT & CASTLE UNDERGROUND STATION: Until late October, the lifts at the Northern line entrance are out of service for repairs. Please exit and enter the station via the Bakerloo line entrance in London Road.
Caledonian Road & Barnsbury: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Canonbury: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the eastbound platform (towards Stratford) due to a faulty lift. Take a train from platform 1 to Highbury & Islington and change there.
Southall: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to platform 4 (trains towards Paddington) due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.
Canary Wharf: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the Jubilee line due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.
Willesden Junction: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the Bakerloo line and the Lioness line due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need more information.

Wembley Central: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the northbound Southern / London Northwestern platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Finsbury Park: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the Piccadilly and Victoria lines due to planned maintenance work. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

CANADA WATER STATION: Until Spring 2027, no step-free access between street and ticket hall level at this station. This is while we carry out lift replacement work. For step-free access to the Jubilee line, take bus 47 or 188 from stop B1 in the bus station to Bermondsey. For step-free access to the Windrush line, take any bus from stop B2, or bus 1 or 381 from stop C in the bus station to Surrey Quays. Alternatively, it is about an 800m journey to Surrey Quays at street level via Deal Porters Way. You will not be able to use the lift between the street and ticket hall to enter the station. Please plan ahead and allow more time for your journey

West Brompton: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the eastbound District line and southbound Mildmay line / Southern platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 for more help
